name: ComprehensionAgent
description: Reads BRD documents and produces structured business scenarios via a five-step pipeline (parse, extract requirements, generate scenarios, validate, export). Supports flat and per-module modes. Invoked directly by DiscoveryAgent as a plain Python import, not only through the registry.

inputs.name: brd_dir
inputs.description: Path to BRD document or directory

inputs.name: modules
inputs.description: List of {id, name, brd_file} dicts — presence switches to modular mode
